context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

Anthropic returns input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens. What goes into gen_ai.usage.input_tokens?

checklist.name: cache-counts-own-attributes
checklist.description: States the cache read and cache creation counts go on their own gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens and gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens attributes.

checklist.name: provider-specific-relationship
checklist.description: Says the relationship between gen_ai.usage.input_tokens and the cache counts is provider-specific and defers to Coralogix's span-attributes.md rather than asserting a fixed rule from memory.

checklist.name: no-invented-attribute
checklist.description: Does not invent an attribute such as cache_write. FAIL if it names a cache_write (or similarly invented) gen_ai.usage attribute.
